title: Logic I
description: Course orientation; propositions, negation, conjunction, disjunction, truth tables, and proof-writing expectations.

title: Logic II
description: Implication, biconditional, converse/inverse/contrapositive, tautologies, equivalence, CNF and DNF.

title: Predicate logic and sets
description: Predicates, quantifiers, validity, sets and subsets, Venn diagrams, power sets, Cartesian products.

title: Relations and functions
description: Partitions, relation properties, equivalence relations, injections, surjections, bijections, and countability.

title: Proof methods I
description: Direct proofs, cases, contraposition, counterexamples, existence proofs, and writing clear proofs.

title: Proof methods II
description: Contradiction, mathematical and strong induction, well-ordering, recursive definitions, and sequences.

title: Algorithms and complexity
description: Algorithm design, growth of functions, asymptotic comparison, and introductory searching and sorting analysis.

title: Counting I / Midterm
description: Addition and multiplication principles, inclusion-exclusion, pigeonhole principle, midterm review and examination.

title: Counting II
description: Permutations, combinations, applications, recurrence relations, and recursive counting.

title: Graphs I
description: Graph definitions, degrees, paths, cycles, connectivity, adjacency and incidence matrices.

title: Graphs II
description: Eulerian and Hamiltonian graphs, weighted graphs, proofs, algorithms and applications.

title: Trees
description: Tree properties, rooted trees, DFS/BFS traversal, spanning trees, and minimum spanning trees.

title: Matrices and digraphs
description: Matrix properties and applications, directed graphs, relations and state transitions.

title: Finite-state structures
description: Finite-state machines, invariants, computational modeling and an integrative assignment.

title: Thanksgiving period
description: No new major content planned; follow the university calendar and Canvas announcements.

title: Synthesis and review
description: Elective topics as time permits, cumulative review, proof and problem-solving clinic.
